install.heading: How to download & install
install.subheading: You'll be playing in under a minute. No weird setup.

Desktop.title: Download the installer
Desktop.description: Hit the download button and save LostieLauncher-win-Setup.exe to your computer.

Desktop.title: Run the installer
Desktop.description: Double-click the downloaded file. The launcher installs and opens automatically when it's done.

Desktop.title: Pick your game
Desktop.description: Open the Library, press Download on the game you want and wait for the download to finish.

Desktop.title: Play!
Desktop.description: Hit Play from My games. The launcher updates itself and keeps your games up to date.

Android.title: Download the APK
Android.description: Hit the download button on your phone and save the LostieLauncher APK to your device.

Android.title: Install the launcher
Android.description: Open the downloaded APK and tap Install. If you don't have Kirin, the app that runs the games, the launcher will ask you to install it.

Android.title: Pick your game
Android.description: Open the Library and tap Download on the game you want. It keeps downloading in the background with a progress notification.

Android.title: Play!
Android.description: Tap Play from My games and Kirin opens the game. The launcher updates itself and keeps your games up to date.

note.Desktop: If Windows SmartScreen shows a warning, click "More info" and then "Run anyway". The installer is signed with an independent developer signature that Windows doesn't know well yet — it isn't dangerous.
note.Android: If Android blocks the installation, allow your browser to install unknown apps when prompted and open the APK again. You need Android 8.0 or later and Kirin 0.4.0 or later, which the launcher helps you install.

footer.disclaimer: LostieLauncher is a fan project. It is not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak or The Pokémon Company.
